champion.builds: THE BEST EKKO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ekko Bot build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Lich Bane. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame and finish with Void Staff. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 54.1% winrate over 85 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ekko Bot build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Hail of Blades as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Scorch in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Lich Bane, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Nashor's Tooth as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and Shadowflame. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 52.5% win rate over 80 matches. Situational Ekko Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ekko build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ekko runes page.
